dreamteamer.title: Web
dreamteamer.description: dt web: the dreamteamer UI in the pane beside an agent chat or in a browser, over a workspace on your own machine — the extension's pages on one loopback listener, opened in one step (dt web open), at a Read, Edit or Admin level the server enforces. The page and the chat share place and selection through a prompt hook. Adds dt web, dt serve, /web:show and web rows in dt doctor.
